sections.title: PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
sections.textPreview:
Available Sizes
• Style 221AA is available in 3 – 4"/DN80 – DN100
• Style 221FB is available in 4 – 5"/DN100 – DN150
Maximum Working Pressure
• 50 psi/345 kPa
Application
• This product is designed specifically for use in the flue gas desulfurization industry to join shouldered end spray
nozzles to shouldered alloy or Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic (FRP) pipe.
• Provides for infinitely variable nozzle positioning to minimize wall impingement on the absorber.
Pipe Materials
• Alloy
• Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic (FRP)
NOTE
• Supplied with EndSeal gaskets
